title: underbed storage
text:
underbed storage. UPDATE BELOW: I purchased these to put my grandsons clothes - under the cots I have put up. Works really great - I like that there is a handle on the front and at the both ends. The zipper top is clear so you can see what is in there. And the clear vinyl keeps dust off and clothes clean. I like them. The fold up pretty small and square too. There is a bottom stiffener to help keep it useful. The dividers are a little less wonderful - but work. You press velcro on the side to get them in - they sort of work. But they are super necessary in my mind. You get 2 organizers and each organizer has 3 separators and 1 stiffener for the bottom. They are a darker gray with a brown sewn edging. The handles are a nylon strapping - about 1 1/2" wide and sewn on. I like them. I think I'll be able to use them for a while - we'll see. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
6/17/2020... After having loaded up my grandsons clothing and attempting to use the zippers - MEH. Really disappointing. SIGH. I hate the updates that aren't stellar... The zippers just don't want to make the corners... so we end up only opening just to the corner - makes it a bit more challenging to access all the clothing - but they fit perfectly under their cots. Zippers need a better frame possibly? Not sure - but they are a design flaw. If you don't have to get in and out of them very often - or fully open the top - maybe they're ok.

product_metadata.title: Lifewit Under Bed Clothes Organizer Large Adjustable Dividers Storage Bag with Durable Fabric, Reinforced Handle, 4 Clear Window for Clothing, Shoes, Blankets, Sweaters, Grey, 2 Pack
features: Adjustable Dividers: With adjustable dividers, the size of storage space can be adjusted according to your clothes size to save storage space. In addition to storing clothes, it’s a good choice to store shoes, blankets, etc.
Large Capacity: Each bag measures 37.8 × 15.7 × 5.9 in / 96 × 40 × 15 cm, with capacity 57.6 L. It is spacious for your to store clothes, shoes, blankets, sweaters.

Erect Structure: All sides and partitions are fitted with firm and sturdy straight board, after placing your stuffs into it, the organizer won’t fall down. This spacious underbed storage box will properly protect your items from being crushed.

Sturdy Handle & Zipper: The handle is sewn to the side plate to strengthen the load-bearing capacity and extend its service life. Equipped with #5 stainless steel zippers which are hard to be broken, and can be used for a longer period of time.

Versatility: The storage bag set can be used for under the bed or closet. It is suitable for dormitory, attic, basement and bedroom use. Also, the foldable design allows it to be easily stored when not in use.

details.Material: Thick Non-woven Fabric and Sturdy Straight Board
